content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of glucagon for individuals who are at a high risk of experiencing severe hypoglycemia and are unable to independently consume carbohydrates to raise their blood glucose levels. It is essential that family members and caregivers of these individuals receive proper training on how to administer glucagon effectively. Glucagon is available in multiple formulations, including intranasal preparations and ready-to-inject options, which provide flexibility to accommodate the specific needs and preferences of the patient.
